Subject: Hearthwell — Request: custom commitment structure (VP/CFO clearance needed)

Marissa / Markus —

Summary: Hearthwell (Brian Holt) is asking for a bespoke three-year commitment with an aggressive first-year discount to get their VPC/private deployment across 6 regions. This is a strategic prospect for our medtech vertical (large reference potential + channel partner interest). They’ve asked for a 35% first-year effective discount and deeper onboarding concessions (waived setup + custom integration support).

Why we’re escalating: the requested first-year economics fall outside standard commercial guardrails and need VP/CFO clearance (discount + waived fees + extended SLA credits). Ive attached the SOW draft and the pricing model for transparency.

Proposed commercial posture (what I recommend we approve):
- Term: 36 months (annual invoices)
- First-year effective discount: 30% off list; additional 5% rebate tied to 24-month usage thresholds (net 35% if thresholds met)
- Year 2/3: step-down to 15% / 10% list discount
- Waive one-time setup fee (standard $18k) if they sign within 30 days
- SLA: standard Bronze SLA with a single 30-day credit cap; require Legal to keep credit cap language (no unlimited credits)

Asks:
1) Request VP/CFO signoff to proceed with a conditional approval on these terms or counter direction.
2) Permission to offer the staged rebate structure (triggers are in the attached spreadsheet).

Attachments: HW_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub), hearthwell-pricing-model.xlsx (pricing scenarios)

Im available this afternoon for a quick 15-min sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Sergio
